# Softree Technology

> Softree builds production-grade software for ambitious enterprise teams. AI agents, web apps, Microsoft 365 ecosystems, and data products. Microsoft Gold Partner. Based in India, shipping globally.

## What we do

- **AI & Automation** — agentic AI systems, generative AI fine-tuned on enterprise data, retrieval-augmented workflows
- **Web Development** — production web apps with Next.js, React, TypeScript, scalable to enterprise loads
- **Microsoft Power Platform** — Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate, custom MVPs, Power Platform governance
- **Data & Analytics** — Microsoft Fabric, Power BI dashboards, data engineering, real-time business intelligence
- **Digital Workspace** — SharePoint intranets, SPFx web parts, Microsoft 365 ecosystems, mobile apps

## Engagement model

- Fixed-scope, fixed-price contracts
- Senior engineering squads (no junior ladders)
- Direct Slack with engineers — not account managers
- Median project ship time: ~47 days
- Available for 2 new projects · Q2 2026
